sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman, dark swept side-part waved hair with curled ends/brows, silver drop earrings and pearl necklace. Navy broad-lapel jacket with small gold round pin viewer right over purple crossed V blouse and dark flower-like center ornament at lower crop. Serious mouth, blue backdrop. Preserve hair/jewelry/outfit/crop/light, short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman, short brown side-part waved bob/brows and small gold hoop earrings. Light blue garment with broad rounded pale grey collar; clipped small dark ID at viewer-right lower edge, unreadable. Viewer-left hand holds upright clear narrow test tube with pale stopper, slightly bottom cropped. Serious mouth and blue background. Keep hand/tube/hair/collar/ID/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman near frontal slightly leftward, swept grey-brown waved bob/brows/pearl stud earrings. Brown broad-lapel coat with fine pale piping over small cream/brown patterned blouse; source-cropped red and tan books/folders viewer left. Serious closed mouth and blue background. Keep hair/earrings/books/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman with grey-brown side-part waves and low nape curls/brows, thick round dark glasses over eyes. White lab coat/high pale pointed shirt/blue round collar brooch, clipped white blue-topped ID viewer left, cropped green hardback books viewer right. Serious mouth, blue backdrop. Preserve hair/glasses/brooch/ID/books/outfit/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman near frontal slight left turn, blonde-grey rolled hair/brows under dark brown soft hat. Olive coat with small blue/gold round lapel badge viewer left, double strand pearl necklace. Serious mouth and blue background. Retain hat/hair/pearls/badge/coat/crop/light, short broad fitted mascot neck; badge text unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal woman, white-grey swept-back hair rolled at nape/brows and small gold textured earrings. Pale cream scarf over pink/off-white blouse, cream wrap with sparse black dots; pearl necklace with gold oval center ornament. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve hair/jewelry/wrap dots/layers/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man with short neat brown side-part hair/brows, brown moustache only and clean chin. Olive-brown broad-lapel field coat/shoulder tabs over high folded white neck cloth. Restrained slight smile, blue backdrop. Preserve moustache only/hair/brows/clothing/crop/light, short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short dark side-part curled quiff/brows, small dark moustache only and clean chin, round fine-rim glasses over eyes. Dark olive cable-knit V sweater over cream pointed collar with small round gold throat fastener. Restrained slight smile and blue background. Keep hair/moustache/glasses/knit/collar/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.
